dialogues.speaker: Araesha
dialogues.text: More delicious riddles are needed, before Festival Utsava. Still not enough...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Something on your mind?

dialogues.speaker: Araesha
dialogues.text: Ah, Nara friend.

dialogues.speaker: Araesha
dialogues.text: Nara friend knows not about Festival Utsava, thus knows not about Araesha's worries.

dialogues.speaker: Araesha
dialogues.text: When Festival Utsava starts, every Aranara returns to Vanarana, and many of them come to Araesha for riddles...

dialogues.speaker: Araesha
dialogues.text: But Araesha doesn't have enough riddles for everyone to eat...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About riddles...

dialogues.speaker: Araesha
dialogues.text: Seeing Aranara failing to solve the riddles, Araesha feels happy.

dialogues.speaker: Araesha
dialogues.text: If Aranara solves the riddles, Araesha feels happy.

dialogues.speaker: Araesha
dialogues.text: All in all, riddles make Aranara happy.

dialogues.speaker: Araesha
dialogues.text: But Araesha has never provided a riddle for Nara. Araesha should think again, what happy riddles will Nara like?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: See you...

dialogues.speaker: Araesha
dialogues.text: Goodbye, Nara friend. Don't miss the feast of riddles.

dialogues.speaker: Araesha
dialogues.text: Nara solved all Araesha's riddles. Nara riddles must be fresh, too.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What's on your mind?

dialogues.speaker: Araesha
dialogues.text: #Ah, smart Nara {NICKNAME}.

dialogues.speaker: Araesha
dialogues.text: #At Festival Utsava, Nara {NICKNAME} solved every delicious riddle of Araesha.

dialogues.speaker: Araesha
dialogues.text: Araesha doesn't have enough riddles.

dialogues.speaker: Araesha
dialogues.text: #Nara {NICKNAME}. Nara riddles must be very fresh, no?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Yes, very delicious.

dialogues.speaker: Araesha
dialogues.text: #Araesha knew it. Nara {NICKNAME} ate many fresh riddles thus ate up all Araesha's riddles.

dialogues.speaker: Araesha
dialogues.text: Araesha wants a riddle match with little Nara.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: No, they taste bad.

dialogues.speaker: Araesha
dialogues.text: #Is that so... Guess it's because Nara {NICKNAME} is smart.

dialogues.speaker: Araesha
dialogues.text: That's why Araesha's riddles are eaten up...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Araesha
dialogues.text: #Bye, smart Nara {NICKNAME}.

dialogues.speaker: Araesha
dialogues.text: Oh... Nara, so smart. The taller, the smarter! It's true!
